collapsedTitle.content: Fireship explores a chaotic week in cybersecurity, detailing how vulnerabilities in Optimizely, Java, and Nginx impacted major websites globally. The breakdown highlights how attackers leveraged these flaws to inject malware and gain system control, while also showcasing how modern development tools like Paper are being used to redesign applications during such security events.
